learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to understand the thermodynamic fundamentals of steam power plants, refrigeration machines, and heating systems, as well as their optimization possibilities, and to classify them in terms of energy technology and economics.
Students are able to calculate complete processes and evaluate them exergistically.
Students are able to independently develop complex problem solutions.
Students are able to make planning decisions based on evaluation criteria.

syllabus_topics: Steam power processes - fundamentals and optimization
Vapor compression processes - fundamentals and optimization
Combined heat and power / thermally driven refrigeration processes
Students can investigate energetic aspects of technical designs and find optimal solutions.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam (grade).
bibliography: Lecture, exercise, and practical documents in moodle
